lines.text: The priest goes outside the camp, slaughters one bird over fresh water, and sprinkles the healed person twelve times.
The person washes, shaves, and bathes, then stays outside his tent seven days and shaves all his hair again on the seventh day.
On the eighth day the priest presents the offerings at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting and puts guilt offering blood on the right ear, thumb, and big toe.
A poor person brings one male goat as a guilt offering, plus two turtledoves or two young pigeons, whichever he can afford.
If the mildew spreads again after the house is replastered, the house is unclean and must be torn down.
